body: A retained proof bundle is available with proof_sha256 283e7848f02d260aff667de5f193536bbcda406f631619b6de6f2365a07918b2. It traverses ForeignTwin, WorkGraph, bounded Atlas context, ProviderGraph, AuthorityGraph, native WorkGraph/EffectKernel, ObjectFabric, ReceiptEnvelope, EvidenceGraph, and institutional replay. Ten live-store checks and four counterfactuals pass. The artifact binds the Bernstein #3880 owned validation snapshot while explicitly refusing promotion to upstream completion.
